name: Lip Service ~Classmate no JK wa Pinsaro Jou~
original_name: リップサービス～クラスメイトのJKはピンサロ嬢～
source: I've been masturbating to AV a lot lately and it's not enough... Since I turned 18, I decided to go to a pink salon for the first time as a commemoration.
